svg.title: Development assistant — full pipeline flow
svg.desc: Complete execution flow from project brief through clarification, plan and contract gates, feature selection, and the per-feature implementation cycle: worker, git, validator, human gate, merge.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should I put in doc0_project_brief.md?')
sendPrompt('How does the CTO clarification loop work?')
g.text: CTO reads doc0 · asks one question
one ? per round · appends to clarification_log

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What if I want to skip a clarification question?')
sendPrompt('What does the CTO shared plan contain?')
g.text: CTO writes shared plan to doc0

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should I check before approving the plan?')
sendPrompt('How does the CTO generate the three contracts?')
g.text: self-consistency check · every feature has a test suite

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should I check when reviewing the contracts?')
g.text: highest-leverage gate — reject if criteria are vague

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the feature selection menu work?')
sendPrompt('What does the CTO spawn plan decide?')
sendPrompt('How does git_ops.py set up branches?')
sendPrompt('What tools does the worker agent use?')
g.text: file_read · file_write · test_runner — zero git access
writes source files · runs tests · fills milestone report

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does git_node do after the worker finishes?')
g.text: commit · push · gh pr create --base develop
Validator node (Gemini) — runs before your review
reads doc3 test suite + milestone report · zero git access

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I approve a PR in the pipeline?')
g.text: Human gate — you review PR on GitHub
code already passed spec · python run.py gh-check F-01-001

g.onclick: sendPrompt('When does the pipeline merge the PR?')

svg.text: memory.json updated · next worker gets filtered context
